gripOrHq.title: Synchronized Attack on HQ
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. For each card stored in HQ, the Corp either pays [2] or discards that card.

gripOrHq.title: Swiss Bank Account
gripOrHq.rulesText: You may use the following abilities whenever you pay any cost or penalty. [T]: Gain [2]. [3], [T]: Gain [6]. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

gripOrHq.title: Invisibility
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Invisibility when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Sneak Preview
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Finders Keepers
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.

heapOrArchives.title: Sneak Preview
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Sneak Preview
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Rent-I-Con
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

rig.title: Invisibility
rig.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Invisibility when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Rent-I-Con
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: Chiba Bank Account
rig.rulesText: [1], [T]: Gain [4]. You may use this ability whenever you pay any cost or penalty. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

rig.title: Airport Locker
rig.rulesText: [5], [T]: Search your stack for a program, and install that program, if you can. Shuffle your stack afterwards. You may use this ability during an encounter with a piece of ice. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

scoreArea.title: On-Call Solo Team
scoreArea.rulesText: A: Do 1 meat damage. Use this ability only if Runner is tagged.

ice.title: Haunting Inquisition
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Runner cannot make another run during his or her next six actions.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Planning Consultants
root.rulesText: Look at the top five cards of R&D and arrange them in any order you choose.

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.

ice.title: Ball and Chain
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.
